purpose: Test whether five narrow semantic response shapes plus a lossless annotated sentence table can represent all frozen process targets without repeating Phase-3 quote, role, or compactness failures.

phase3_failures_addressed: free-form quote reproduction caused invalid non-contiguous evidence
one universal record shape did not require alternative-plus-limit or challenge-plus-response roles
compact reading omitted an earlier minority signal despite full conversation availability
a fluent interpretation overclaimed what its cited position evidence supported
intervention: show the complete conversation as chronological sentence rows with visible short aliases
let the model make semantic judgments but restrict source citation to aliases
require evidence roles specific to each of five bounded questions
cap each semantic job at four materially distinct records
include the complete auxiliary ledger or omit it whole by byte budget
failure_derived_hypothesis.mechanism_not_claim: The interface reduces avoidable source-custody and role-omission failure modes; it does not make the model's semantic interpretation correct.

stop_rules: Do not make a provider call under this contract.
Stop if any protected target cannot be expressed with its required view-specific evidence roles.
Stop if any stable alias fails to resolve one-to-one to a source sentence span.
Stop if the complete annotated stress conversation exceeds 24000 bytes after the auxiliary ledger is omitted whole.
Do not add deterministic semantic prefilters, repairs, or relevance gates to force a pass.
Do not modify Phase-1 ledgers or existing Phase-2 and Phase-3 evidence.
